shared_elements: upright anthropomorphic figure with a raised arm
figure shown in profile/frontal-limbed pose occupying the main field
quadruped or animal-like form (A: animals; B: bird-headed hybrid)
linear incised/pecked contour drawing of figures
justification: Both surfaces show an upright anthropomorphic figure with one arm raised, a near-universal motif, and both include animal or hybrid-animal forms, but nothing more specific corresponds. A consists of tiny schematic stick-like figures and animals scattered over a field with no attributes or setting, while B shows a single large, anatomically elaborated bird-headed winged figure with feathered wings, fringed garment and a handled vessel, facing stylised rosette-bearing plants and set beneath a band of sign-like marks; the conventions of depiction are wholly different.
